title: Travelling Waves in Wolbachia Spread Dynamics
summary: Wolbachia, a maternally transmitted endosymbiont, offers a powerful biological control strategy for mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue, Zika, and malaria. We develop an integro-difference equation (IDE) model that integrates Wolbachia's nonlinear growth with spatially explicit mosquito dispersal kernels to study invasion dynamics in heterogeneous landscapes. Analytical results establish the existence and uniqueness of monotone traveling waves and provide explicit estimates of invasion speeds as functions of dispersal and growth parameters.
